title: my.access - University of Toronto Libraries
subtitle: The University of Toronto Libraries system is the largest academic library in Canada and consists of 44 libraries located on three university campuses: St. George, Mississauga and Scarborough.
article: Connect to this resource using your UTORid
This resource is licensed for your use by the University of Toronto Libraries. Off-campus access is available to current University of Toronto students, staff and faculty.

For assistance with determining or obtaining your UTORid, please contact us at reader.reg@utoronto.ca. If you are eligible to obtain a UTORid, library staff will provide you with activation instructions.
If you know your UTORid but you have forgotten your password, please contact the Information Commons Help Desk for assistance:
Information Commons staff will assist you with resetting your UTORid password, after which you can use it to access licensed e-resources from off-campus.
